metadata.title: Resolve Standup Republic entities
metadata.description: Resolve an ambiguous human name, natural-language identifier, or supported provider identifier into stable SR references. For a dated performance, resolve an event; use show for its reusable template. Supply the narrowest plausible entity_types plus optional city/date/provider hints; full date_hint values are RFC3339. Product resolution is connected for event, location, profile, and show; internal Coordination resolution is connected for artifact, active plugin_user, message, project, task, and legacy attachment records. Other requested-only types return resolver_entity_type_not_connected with connected_entity_types. Use sr_entity_get when a canonical ref is already known; slot is a bookable lineup time window and is normally queried with available_slots_v1. Read-only; do not probe unsupported types.

query.description: Human text, name, message excerpt, phone number, email, or provider identifier to resolve into canonical SR references.

items.description: Canonical SR or internal Coordination record type. Product values include application, booking, event, invoice, location, organization, payout_case, profile, show, slot, subscription, and ticket_class. Internal values include artifact, plugin_user, meeting, message, priority_item, project, archived task, task_proposal, attachment (legacy transfer alias), signal, link, coordination_event, activity_event, mcp_tool_call, and operation_run. Use priority_item for the Admin board; archived task is read-only history and returns coordination_task_retired. Use artifact for private immutable R2 content or a verified Google Drive link. Use slot for one bookable lineup time window. Use event for one scheduled occurrence with a date, time, and a venue. Use show only for the reusable show format/template across occurrences; a user may colloquially say 'Show' while referring to an event.

entity_types.description: Schema-valid planner targets include profile, show, slot and the other listed Product records plus internal activity_event, artifact, attachment, coordination_event, link, message, plugin_user, signal, and task. Use event for a dated occurrence and show only for the reusable series/template. Product resolution is connected for event, location, profile, and show; Coordination resolution is connected for artifact, active plugin_user, message, project, task, and legacy attachment records. Requesting only another type returns resolver_entity_type_not_connected. Use sr_entity_get when a canonical ref is already known. Use artifact for private R2 content or verified Google Drive links.

city.description: Optional city hint used to rank otherwise similar candidates.

date_hint.description: Optional date/time hint as a full RFC 3339 timestamp including time and offset. Example: 2026-07-30T20:00:00+02:00. Never pass a date-only value such as 2026-07-30.

provider.description: Optional provider namespace when query contains an identifier from that provider.

limit.description: Maximum number of ranked candidates to return; default 10.

observed_at.description: Full RFC 3339 timestamp with time and UTC offset, for example 2026-07-30T20:00:00+02:00 or 2026-07-30T18:00:00Z. Date-only values such as 2026-07-30 are invalid.

status.description: resolved only when one candidate is safe to select; ambiguous requires clarification; not_found means no candidate matched. invalid, permission_denied, and failed are typed non-success results with machine-readable error evidence.

entity_ref.description: Stable opaque reference for the candidate's canonical SR record.

entity_type.description: Canonical type of this candidate; event means one dated occurrence, show means its reusable format/template.

label.description: Human-readable candidate label containing the most useful distinguishing facts.

confidence.description: Resolver confidence from 0 to 1; not an authorization signal.

reasons.description: Compact reasons why this candidate matched the request.

summary.description: Self-contained distinguishing facts. Event candidates should include the show title, event date/time, venue, and city when available so the match can be explained without a follow-up read.

candidates.description: Ranked canonical candidates with enough facts to distinguish them.

selected_ref.description: Selected stable reference when status is resolved; otherwise null.

error_code.description: Stable machine-readable code for a typed non-success result.

message.description: Safe human-readable explanation of the typed non-success result.

error.description: Structured typed-error evidence; when present, use error.result_status for trace semantics and error.error_code for branching.

details.description: Safe machine-readable diagnostics such as missing_fields, unexpected_fields, expected_shapes, or reconciliation instructions. Never contains secrets or raw Product rows.

metadata.title: Query Standup Republic entities
metadata.description: Run one bounded, versioned query profile for lists, aggregates, timelines, or reports. Read the selected profile's availability, role, scope, filter, select, grouping, and sort contract before calling; do not try guessed profiles or filter probes. Omit select when the profile publishes an answer-ready default. Use at most one supported sort, pass canonical scope_ref when available, and reuse next_cursor unchanged for the same query. Additional safe per-item Gets are usually unnecessary after a complete projection. blocked/unsupported profiles are discoverable but not callable; typed errors state the exact retry contract. Discover current profiles via sr_runtime_health with components:['mcp'], catalog:{kind:'overview'}; fetch exact filters and projection with catalog:{kind:'query',key:'<profile>'}.

profile.description: Use one exact canonical versioned profile; do not invent aliases. Availability is active, gated, blocked, unsupported, or local-only. employee means Employee and Admin; admin means Admin-only. admin_session_status_v1 [active, role=admin, scope=unscoped, results=operation_run]: the authenticated Admin's current channel-bound temporary approval session, remaining lifetime, and revocation state; available_slots_v1 [active, role=employee, scope=unscoped, results=slot]: available booking slots; omit select for the complete answer-ready slot, event, venue, time, duration, mode, availability, and fee projection; bank_accounting_reconciliation_v1 [active, role=admin, scope=unscoped, results=payout_case]: unmatched bank accounting records; bookings_v1 [active, role=employee, scope=event|profile|show, results=booking]: bounded booking records; city_ticket_sales_v1 [active, role=employee, scope=unscoped, results=event|location]: ticket sales grouped by city; comedian_booking_load_v1 [active, role=employee, scope=unscoped, results=profile]: booking counts grouped by comedian; omit select for the complete answer-ready inventory projection; event_sales_v1 [active, role=employee, scope=event|show, results=event]: event ticket revenue and sales totals; finance_export_scope_v1 [gated, role=admin, scope=unscoped, results=payout_case]: count-only finance export scope preview; separate Finance gate required; internal_activity_feed_v1 [active, role=employee, scope=plugin_user|message|task|attachment, results=activity_event]: sanitized team-visible activity for MCP and Site Coordination operations; never returns message bodies, exact prompts, file grants, or raw tool arguments; internal_artifacts_v1 [active, role=employee, scope=plugin_user|project|task|message|meeting|signal|operation_run, results=artifact]: cursor-paginated canonical Artifacts visible through ownership, explicit grants, or an independently visible linked entity; returns metadata only and never raw content or R2 URLs; internal_coordination_events_v1 [active, role=admin, scope=plugin_user|message|task|attachment, results=coordination_event]: restricted bounded Coordination command events with redacted correlation and no message/task body or file grant; internal_communications_v1 [active, role=employee, scope=plugin_user, results=message]: message history from internal Coordination and connected communication channels; returns bodies only for direct messages involving the authenticated user or sources where that user has an active participant membership; Admin role has no participant bypass; internal_conversations_v1 [active, role=employee, scope=plugin_user, results=message]: one bounded summary row per Coordination, WhatsApp, Slack, or email conversation visible to the authenticated participant; Admin role has no participant bypass; internal_employee_directory_v1 [active, role=employee, scope=person, results=person]: all actor-visible canonical employee identities, including people without current Task or Project involvement, with bounded versioned current-work summaries; internal_meetings_v1 [active, role=employee, scope=plugin_user, results=meeting]: chronological private Meeting list with participant roles, processing state, report/transcript availability, and six typed outcome counts; internal_messages_sent_v1 [active, role=employee, scope=plugin_user|task, results=message]: messages sent by the authenticated plugin user; internal_notifications_v1 [active, role=employee, scope=task|plugin_user, results=task]: the authenticated person's own sanitized Task-notification delivery state; Admin role has no cross-user bypass; internal_priority_board_v1 [active, role=admin, scope=unscoped, results=priority_item]: Admin-only priority board cards; archived Coordination tasks are excluded; internal_projects_v1 [active, role=employee, scope=plugin_user, results=project]: canonical Coordination Projects visible through active Project membership, with global Admin override; internal_signals_v1 [active, role=employee, scope=event|show|profile|message|task, results=signal]: bounded timestamped internal operational signals stored in Coordination D1 by connected Product, communication, meeting, and manual ingestion paths; metadata.description: Validate and freeze one registry-backed Product or internal Coordination action without mutating state. Before declaring an operation unavailable, discover the live registry via sr_runtime_health with components:['mcp'], catalog:{kind:'overview'}, then catalog:{kind:'action',key:'<operation>'} for exact payload and reference requirements. Choose operation by availability, required role, target type, confirmation_policy, use_when/not_for, required references, dependencies, and exact payload guide. A request to move, reschedule, or rebook an existing comedian between slots is booking.move with both source and destination slot refs; resolve ambiguous names through the occupied source slot and never substitute booking.remove. For Event text, the words Memo, Notiz, or Beschreibung alone are ambiguous: ask whether the user means organizer-only internal note, public customer description, or public Event title before calling Prepare. Never infer visibility from a legacy UI label. Omit legacy domain; the server derives it from operation and rejects mismatches. Invalid payloads return machine-readable missing_fields, unexpected_fields, and expected_shapes for one corrected retry. A successful Prepare returns a 48-hour manifest, opaque prepare_token, confirmation_policy, and execution_ready. For not_required operations call Execute immediately without showing a preview or asking again; required operations must wait for explicit user confirmation.

metadata.description: Execute exactly one previously prepared active action after authorization and state revalidation. If Prepare returned confirmation_policy=required, call only after explicit user confirmation; if it returned not_required, call immediately without another user turn. Pass the exact opaque prepare_token plus a caller-generated stable 16-128 character idempotency_key using letters, digits, dot, underscore, tilde, or hyphen; never use manifest_ref as the idempotency key, and likewise never use prepare_token, receipt_ref, or another sr: reference. Reuse the same key only for a retry of the same execution. A succeeded action proves only the operation's canonical internal contract: requested proves durable Main App outbox acceptance only; claim provider acceptance only from post_check.external_effects state provider_accepted, sending only from sent, delivery only from delivered, and reading only from read, each with canonical evidence. Explicitly state not_requested_by_policy, requested, queued, processing, provider_unknown, failed, or unknown; never paraphrase them as sent, delivered, received, published, shared, or successfully dispatched. For an unknown transport outcome, reconcile operation_run_ref with sr_entity_get sections status, receipt, and post_check; never blind-retry with a new key. Gated, blocked, local-only, and unsupported operations remain non-executable in Production.

prepare_token.description: Opaque prepare_token returned by the exact sr_action_prepare call being confirmed. Do not use manifest_ref instead.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-generated stable retry key for this one confirmed execution: 16-128 characters using only letters, digits, dot, underscore, tilde, or hyphen. Example: gp041-show-create-20260723. Reuse the same key only when retrying the same execution. Never copy manifest_ref, prepare_token, receipt_ref, or any sr:... reference into this field.
